nodes.name: Send Alert Email to IT Admin

parameters.content:
## How to wire this up
1. Import & activate this workflow first.
2. Open **IT Ticketing - Main** → Settings → Error Workflow → select this workflow.
3. Update `toRecipients` in Send Alert Email to your real admin address.

n8n runs this automatically when any Main node throws an unhandled error.
